s.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into squares. Spoon a little sweetened cream cheese and apricot jam into the centre and fold the corners in. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Dust with icing sugar and eat at a shop window.

s.note: Holly's cat, who she just calls Cat
s.how: Boil 8 eggs, halve, mash the yolks with mayonnaise and pipe back, then dust with paprika. Beat cream cheese with chives and fill short celery sticks. Lay both out on silver trays for a crowded apartment party.

m.note: Holly's Thursday visits to Sing Sing, $100 a time
m.how: Cut 1kg potatoes into thin fries and fry twice until crisp. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Toast cracked peppercorns in the pan, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Serve with fries and a green salad.

w.how: Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into rounds. Spoon custard into the centre of each and top with blueberries. Brush the edges with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Brush with warm apricot jam. Best eaten outside a jewellery shop.

d.how: Chill 4 coupes and a bottle of champagne or other dry sparkling wine. Drop a sugar cube into each glass and shake 3 dashes of aromatic bitters over it. Add 15ml brandy to each. Tip the glass and pour the sparkling slowly down the side so it doesn't foam over, about 120ml each. Peel 4 long strips of lemon zest, twist them over the drinks to spray the oil and drop them in.
